t: A Sony chip with six cores, built-in GPS and room for eight microphones.
steps: Buy a Spresense main board from an electronics distributor.
Add the Spresense extension board for headphone, microSD and microphone projects.
Get a micro-USB cable that carries data.
Install the free Arduino IDE and add the Spresense board package.
Flash the Sony loader files that match your board package one time.
Upload the Blink example and watch an LED light up.
Try a GPS example outdoors and watch your position appear.
meta: Open Board. From $21. A few stores.
